title: A Survey on Large Language Model Benchmarks
benchmark_measurement: The paper is a broad survey of LLM benchmarks and does not specifically analyze benchmarks in terms of faith/religion. It mentions general bias and safety benchmarks (e.g., StereoSet, CrowS-Pairs, SocialStigmaQA) which may include religious components, but the survey itself does not detail or analyze these aspects.
findings: This paper is a survey of LLM benchmarks and does not contain specific findings related to religion or faith as it does not analyze this dimension of model performance.
